title: terminal not restored when fetch_session fails after raw mode enabled
description: main.rs: enable_raw_mode runs at line 42, fetch_session uses ? at line 51 which returns early from main on failure. Cleanup at lines 66-68 runs for run() errors but NOT for fetch_session failure. Terminal left in raw mode with alternate screen when kithd is unreachable at startup. Panic hook covers panics but not ? early returns. Fix: move fetch_session before enabling raw mode, or use RAII terminal guard.
